messages:
Eva (Support): forwarding from customer: 'Since the retention policy ran last night, several team members with Viewer role report blank rows on the Usage & Metrics dashboard. Only Admins see data.'

Markus (SRE): do we have the retention job logs? which dataset/table is being TTL'd?

Eva (Support): customer org: acme-corp, affected routes: /generate and /embeddings. They attached screenshots showing 0 rows for Viewer users. They said Admins unaffected.

Anita (Analytics): got the retention job trace, job ID: run-2026-02-14-03. It applied a filter by org_id + visibility_score. Looks like we added an extra join that implicitly filters by role_visibility_level.

Shilpa (Product): that join was intended to hide PII for Viewer roles — we did a change last week to enforce "role_masking" at query time. Possible we're masking entire rows instead of just fields.

Markus (SRE): alerts-bot shows the nightly retention completed at 03:12 UTC: 
```
alerts-bot: [INFO] run-2026-02-14-03 completed: 12,432 rows expired for dataset "usage_events_v2"
```
But that doesn't explain Admins seeing data. Looks like the query used for dashboard includes an additional WHERE on role_allowed = true. Can someone paste the exact dashboard query?

Anita (Analytics): dashboard query (simplified):
```
SELECT user_id, route, tokens, timestamp
FROM usage_events_v2 ue
JOIN role_visibility rv ON rv.org_id = ue.org_id
WHERE ue.org_id = 'acme-corp' AND rv.role_allowed = true
AND ue.timestamp >= now() - interval '30 days';
```
If rv.role_allowed is false for Viewer, the JOIN will drop all rows for that role.

Shilpa (Product): yup that explains it — the intent was to apply column-level masking, not inner join. This is a regression from change com-9482.

Eva (Support): customer asks for immediate workaround — they need Viewer access to historical metrics for an upcoming review at 13:00 local.

Markus (SRE): short-term workaround: change dashboard to use LEFT JOIN and COALESCE for masked fields so rows remain but sensitive fields show null. I'll run a canary on the report query.

Markus (SRE): sample fix (will test):
```
SELECT ue.user_id, route, COALESCE(ue.tokens, 0) AS tokens, ue.timestamp
FROM usage_events_v2 ue
LEFT JOIN role_visibility rv ON rv.org_id = ue.org_id
WHERE ue.org_id = 'acme-corp' AND (rv.role_allowed = true OR rv.role_allowed IS NULL)
AND ue.timestamp >= now() - interval '30 days';
```

Shilpa (Product): longer-term: revert com-9482 and add unit tests that verify Viewer role queries still return rows (with masked columns). Filed PR to update tests: PR#5021.

Anita (Analytics): I see 2.1k rows present in raw storage for acme-corp for the period — not deleted. So this is a visibility bug not deletion. Good news.

Eva (Support): relayed to customer: data not deleted, visibility filter caused rows to drop. Offering two options: 1) temporary Admin role for reviewers; 2) ETA for fix (canary in 20m, roll to prod in 2h). They picked option 2.

Markus (SRE): canary deployed to staging dashboards at 12:05 UTC. Monitoring queries for errors.

alerts-bot: [NOTICE] canary-deploy: dashboard-query-patch deployed to canary-host-7

Markus (SRE): canary looks clean, Viewer role shows rows (masked tokens). No errors in 10m sample.

Shilpa (Product): scheduling rollback of com-9482 in the next deploy window if PR passes review. Will also add an audit to retention job to log when role_visibility join is used.

Eva (Support): customer confirmed they can see expected rows in the dashboard. Marking ticket as "escalation - resolved by workaround/patch" and will follow up after full rollback. :thumbsup:

Anita (Analytics): postmortem action: add test vectors for role permutations + dashboard to prevent this. Tracking in ENG-2396.

Markus (SRE): assigning follow-ups: PR#5021 -> Shilpa; ENG-2396 -> Anita; update retention job audit -> Markus.

Shilpa (Product): noted. Thanks team.

Eva (Support): closing loop with customer now, will ask them to re-open if anything else pops up.
